fee_details:
- Joining Fee: Rs.5000
- Annual Fee: Rs.5000 (Waived off on first year spending above Rs.50,000)
- Supplementary card joining fee: Nil
- Supplementary card annual fee: Nil
- Finance charges on cash and retail purchases: 2.99% per month (34.73% per annum)
- Cash withdrawal fee: 2.5% of the amount withdrawn (minimum Rs.500)
- Fee for making payment in cash: Rs.100
- Card replacement fee: Waived
- Duplicate statement fee: Waived
- Late payment fees/ penalty for overdue payment: • Rs.300 for the total payment dues up to Rs.2,000
• Rs.500 for the total payment dues between Rs.2,001 and Rs.5,000
• Rs.1000 for the total payment dues of Rs.5,001 or more
- Over limit penalty: 2% of the over limit amount (minimum of Rs.500)
- Copy request fee or charge slip retrieval fee: Waived
- Dunctuation cheque fee: Waived
- Cheque return fee: Rs.300
- Surcharge on purchase or cancellation of train tickets: As prescribed by the Indian Railways or IRCTC
- Fuel transaction surcharge: 1% of the transaction amount (fuel transaction between Rs.500 and Rs.4000)
- Foreign currency transaction fee: 3.5% of the transaction value
- Mobile alerts for any payment made using their card: Waived
- Hotlisting charges: Waived
- Balance enquiry charges: Waived

key_highlights:
- Cardholders can avail free airport lounge access.
- Attractive cashback offers: This credit card comes loaded with attractive cashback offers when the cardholders use.
- Worldwide acceptance: Axis Bank Reserve Credit Cards are accepted at more than 25 million outlets across the globe.
- Emergency card and replacement: Axis Bank credit card cardholders can call the 24*7 helpline for emergency replacement of a card when they are traveling overseas. The card can be replaced in case of theft or damage.

faqs.1. Is an a Burgundian/black complimentar: No, you are eligible for a complimentary Axis Bank Reserve Private Credit Card if you qualify. For the Axis Bank Reserve Credit Card, you must pay a joining and yearly fee of Rs.5000.
faqs.2. How can I obtain my Axis Bank Reserve: Putting up a request with Axis Bank will allow you to obtain a metal credit card tint. Also, the bank will look over your credit history and any income increase. The bank will extend your limit if you meet its requirements.
faqs.3. Is the Axis Bank Reserve credit card: Yes, the Axis Bank Reserve Credit Card is made of metal.
faqs.4. What is the credit limit for the Axis: The credit limit for the Axis Bank Reserve Credit Card is Rs.5 lakhs.
faqs.5. I need/want a plastic card instead of: You may quickly obtain your metal card. Simply submit a replacement request through the Axis Mobile App, by calling their customer service line on 1860-419-0065.
